rfis: Provide project overview: technology (solar+storage), capacity (MW and MWh), site location (county, state, acreage), target COD, and development stage.
Provide site control documents: leases, easements, purchase options, and title report.
Provide zoning and permitting status: zoning designation, ordinance applicability, conditional use permit application, and CEQA status.
Provide interconnection documents: CAISO queue position, cluster study, interconnection agreement, POI, and network upgrade estimates.
Provide offtake documents: PPA, tolling agreement, or merchant assumptions, including counterparty credit information.
Provide CAPEX budget: detailed cost breakdown, escalation, contingency, and EPC contract.
Provide schedule: milestone dates, COD, and procurement plan.
Provide equipment supply agreements: POs and lead times for transformers, modules, and BESS.
Provide environmental surveys: biological, cultural, wetland, and any other required studies.
Provide tax credit documentation: beginning-of-construction evidence and ITC/PTC qualification.
Provide financing plan: sources & uses, debt term sheet, and equity commitment.
Provide community/tribal consultation records, community benefits agreement (CBA), and environmental justice screening.

agency_actions.agency: Napa County Planning, Building, and Environmental Services
agency_actions.action: Engage to verify zoning designation and initiate conditional use permit application and CEQA review.
agency_actions.why: To confirm the project is permitted under Napa County ag-land restrictions and to identify any kill-switch issues early.

agency_actions.agency: California Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW)
agency_actions.action: Engage for California Endangered Species Act consultation and potential incidental take permit.
agency_actions.why: To assess biological constraints, seasonal windows, and mitigation requirements for sensitive species.

agency_actions.action: Engage for Section 7 consultation if federal nexus exists (e.g., federal permits or funding).
agency_actions.why: To evaluate impacts on federally listed species and ensure compliance with the Endangered Species Act.

agency_actions.action: Engage for NPDES Construction Stormwater Permit and any 401 water quality certification.
agency_actions.why: To ensure compliance with water quality regulations and avoid construction delays.

agency_actions.action: Engage to confirm interconnection queue position, study status, and network upgrade requirements.
agency_actions.why: To assess interconnection feasibility, timeline, and cost exposure critical to project viability.

agency_actions.action: Engage to confirm eligibility for the 6,000 MW NQC procurement program and resource adequacy requirements.
agency_actions.why: To validate offtake marketability and revenue certainty for the project.

agency_actions.action: Engage for guidance on ITC/PTC beginning-of-construction rules and eligibility.
agency_actions.why: To ensure tax credit eligibility, which represents ~30-40% of project value, and avoid cliff exposure.

agency_actions.action: Engage to assess agricultural land impact and mitigation requirements.
agency_actions.why: To address ag-land preservation concerns and secure necessary approvals for solar+storage on agricultural land.
